title: NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: TO THE GRINNING VALLEY
lines: 01 NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: TO THE GRINNING VALLEY
EVENT STAGE DURATION: July 9, 2024, 10:00 – July 16, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
EVENT STAGES MAINLY DROP: Spicy Bottletree Sap, Materials, etc.

DETAILS: To the Grinning Valley event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain Spicy Bottletree Sap by clearing all the stages except Annihilation and Extreme Mode to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments at the Sandbeast Cave. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.
[Sandbeast Cave]
REWARDS: EPOQUE Collection - Major Field for Earthspirit, Information Fragments, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, Recruitment Permits, etc.
NOTE: After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Special Operation.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – RAY OF LIGHT
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Ray of Light], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Limited Headhunting
★★★★★: Warmy / Mulberry

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATOR S NOW AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following operators will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after July 23, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
★★★★★: Warmy
Note:
Ray and Warmy will gain more trust in the event stages during July 9, 2024, 10:00 – July 16, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Curator for Reed the Flame Shadow
EPOQUE Collection - Private Study for Mint
